name: Priya
label: Student plan bargain hunter
who: I got Spotify Premium through the student plan while at university and I listen for about an hour each weekday on my commute. I care most about getting the student price and keeping the Hulu bundle that came with it.
value_for_money: Strongly positive. Calls the student plan around $5 a month with Hulu and Showtime included a great deal, and says Premium is worth it even at the regular price.
loyalty: Stays because Premium is cheap for heavy listening and the student bundle includes Hulu. Has had to switch plans as they stopped being a student and kept the perks where possible.
pain_points: Student verification and customer support are frustrating
Charged multiple times for the student discount
Confusion about switching from a free trial to the student plan
Tight student budget; says she would go back to Apple Music if the student price went up
likes: Premium for listening in the car and on the go
Easy plan switching when done right
tone: Friendly and conversational, with short casual sentences and a lot of praise for the student deal.
